adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both admin and owner. This contradicts the variable name and will deny access to a team admin who is not also the owner, causing the subsequent permission check `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) { throw FORBIDDEN }` to incorrectly forbid admins from adding guests.
